responsibility: This file implements the concrete ASCII and Unicode themes used by the text-art subsystem to translate abstract cell kinds into printable glyphs. It owns the mapping for rulers, text borders, vertical arrows, interprocedural depth markers, CFG connectors, and tree connectors, as well as helper logic for painting vertical arrows and for turning generic line-direction sets into either simple ASCII symbols or Unicode box-drawing characters.
same_name_distinction: Defines the concrete glyph mappings and helper behavior for ascii_theme and unicode_theme, including line art and arrow painting; unlike gcc/text-art/theme.h, it is the implementation of theme-specific character selection.
